title: 第2364章 返航第2363章 升环
slug: 自完美世界开始第2369章唐昊
content_zh:
片刻后，轮流尝试了一番十万年魂技的楚风回到了船上，他找到船长斯摩拉，吩咐道：“掉头回斗罗大陆，从接近海神岛的航线走。”
武魂殿多年前曾进攻过海神岛，魂师界虽然没多少人知道海神岛的存在，斯摩拉却是在此次出海前得知了，因为楚风和比比东说过，回去的时候可能要接近海神岛，斯摩拉身为船长自然要知道海神岛在哪。
“是，长老。”
斯摩拉应声，见楚风没有别的吩咐后，当即去安排调转航向。
楚风站在甲板上，周围的天地元气快速汇聚而来，经过天魔魂核的转化成为自身魂力。
十万年魂技威力变大的同时，消耗自然随之提升，‘狂雷闪’那刹那万米的极速就是用魂力换来的。
楚风估摸着以封号斗罗的身体素质，面对他全力催动的狂雷闪，估计会被直接创飞。
此次出海，本来还要探索一下日月大陆的，可是楚风之前用命运魂技试了一下。
结果发现日月大陆距离斗罗大陆太过遥远，他乘船去日月大陆要花好几年，飞过去虽然能更快，却也很耗时间。
因此他打消了前往日月大陆的念头。
要是放在地球上，一座大陆每年的移动速度就几厘米，以几千年后日月大陆与斗罗大陆相撞的情况来看，此时的日月大陆和斗罗大陆之间应该也就隔着几百米……
两个大陆上的魂师，应该早在很多年前就发现了对方的存在。
但，斗罗星自有规则在，地球上的常识并不适用于此。
所以会出现眼下这种情况，明明两个大陆数千年后就会相撞，可此刻却隔着很遥远的距离。
‘没必要强求邪眼暴君魂环，这种精神类魂环……完全有更好的选择。’
楚风心中暗自道。
天梦冰蚕怎么说也是百万年魂兽，等他过段时间实力上去了，完全能将天梦冰蚕作为自己的魂环。
到时候有百万年魂环能量为引子，他的前几个魂环也能完成质变，成为百万年魂环。
‘帝天蹦跶不了几个月了，到时候顺便再把它干掉。’
想到帝天常年在星斗大森林深入，楚风心中难免升起一丝忌惮。

既然这个团战世界有斗罗大陆第二部的凶兽，那么第三部的‘银龙王’估计也是存在的。
这位银龙王可是实打实的神级，战力似乎等同于一级神只，也就是神界的主神，此时就沉睡在星斗大森林深处。
要不是斗罗神界人类神只势大，银龙王不敢冒头，现在这斗罗星谁是主人还不一定呢。
‘按照主神空间的评级，银龙王放在AA级里都不算弱，封号斗罗也就B级、BB级这样了……’
楚风思索着接下来的计划。
他要猎杀天梦冰蚕，帝天不会坐视不理，所以必然会和帝天对上，那么在帝天要被他击杀时，银龙王会不会脑抽跳出来？
这要是给他来上一下……
‘看样子得找个护身符，让银龙王忌惮之下不敢对我动手。’
楚风很快就想到了对策。
修罗神的神位。
content_en:
After a while, Chu Feng, who had taken turns to try out a hundred thousand-year soul skill, returned to the ship. He found the captain Smola and ordered: "Turn around and return to Douluo Continent, and take the route close to Poseidon Island."
Wuhundian had attacked Poseidon Island many years ago. Although not many people in the soul master world knew about the existence of Poseidon Island, Smola learned about it before going to sea this time, because Chu Feng and Bibi Dong had said that they might be close to Poseidon Island when they returned. As a captain, Smola naturally had to know where Poseidon Island was.
"Yes, elder."
Smola responded, and after seeing that Chu Feng had no other instructions, he immediately went to arrange to change the course.
Chu Feng stood on the deck, and the vitality of the surrounding world quickly gathered, and was transformed into his own soul power after being transformed by the demon soul core.
As the power of a hundred thousand year soul skill increases, the consumption will naturally increase accordingly. The top speed of 10,000 meters at the moment of 'Crazy Thunder Flash' is obtained with soul power.
Chu Feng estimated that with the title Douluo's physical strength, he would be directly knocked away when faced with the crazy thunder flash that he activated with all his strength.
This time I went to sea, I originally wanted to explore the Sun and Moon Continent, but Chu Feng tried it with the destiny soul skill before.
It turned out that the Sun and Moon Continent was too far away from the Douluo Continent. It would take him several years to get to the Sun and Moon Continent by boat. Although flying there was faster, it was also very time-consuming.
Therefore, he gave up the idea of ​​going to the Sun and Moon Continent.
If placed on the earth, a continent would move only a few centimeters per year. Judging from the collision between the Sun-Moon Continent and the Douluo Continent thousands of years later, there should be only a few hundred meters between the Sun-Moon Continent and the Douluo Continent at this time...
The soul masters on the two continents should have discovered each other's existence many years ago.
However, Douluo Planet has its own rules, and common sense on Earth does not apply here.
So there is a situation like this. It is obvious that the two continents will collide in thousands of years, but they are separated by a long distance at the moment.
‘There is no need to force the Evil Eye Tyrant Soul Ring, this kind of spiritual soul ring… there are completely better choices. ’
Chu Feng thought to himself.
After all, Tianmeng Ice Silkworm is a million-year-old soul beast. When his strength increases over time, he will be able to use Tianmeng Ice Silkworm as his soul ring.
When the time comes, with the energy of the million-year soul ring as a guide, his first few soul rings will also be able to complete their qualitative transformation and become a million-year soul ring.
‘Di Tian won’t be able to jump around for a few months, so we’ll kill him by the way. ’
Thinking that Di Tian has been deep in the Star Dou Forest all year round, Chu Feng inevitably felt a twinge of fear in his heart.
Since there are ferocious beasts from the second part of Douluo Continent in this team battle world, then the ‘Silver Dragon King’ from the third part probably also exists.
This Silver Dragon King is a real god, and his combat power seems to be equivalent to that of a first-level god, that is, the main god of the God Realm. He is currently sleeping deep in the Star Dou Forest.
If it weren't for the overwhelming power of the human gods in the Douluo God Realm, the Silver Dragon King wouldn't dare to take the lead, and it's not certain who is the master of the Douluo Star now.
'According to the rating of the main god space, the Silver Dragon King is not weak even in the AA level, and the titled Douluo is only in the B level or BB level...'
Chu Feng thought about his next plan.
He wanted to hunt down Tianmeng Ice Silkworm, and Di Tian would not sit idly by, so he would definitely confront Di Tian. So when Di Tian was about to be killed by him, would the Silver Dragon King jump out of his mind?
If this were done to him...
‘Looks like I need to find a talisman to make the Silver Dragon King afraid to attack me. ’
Chu Feng quickly thought of a countermeasure.
The position of God Shura.
